messages:
elaine: Quick sync — we need a concise acceptance checklist for Optimize Toolkit v1 (batching/caching/quant) before next week's PD review. I sketched a 'greenlight' criteria below. Please comment with must-haves, edge cases, and customer-driven asks.

kevin: +1. Add a throughput baseline and p50/p95 latency target per model. also define load-test script.

sophia: please include 'graceful fallback' acceptance (auto-fallback to non-quant/ smaller batch) and an SLA around error-rate increase during rollout. Customers will care.

ravi: from product — we need launch gating: (a) two pilot customers signed, (b) cost delta < 20% for typical workloads, (c) no regression in accuracy for critical prompts. can we measure that automatically?

luca: ops note — quantized kernels only on T4/GA100 for now; if we enable 4-bit on older HW, we need a compatibility matrix and perf runbook. also watch memory fragmentation with large batch sizes.

deploy-bot: canary job queued for 'optkit/acceptance/perf-suite' — ETA 2h

kevin: draft checklist (feel free to edit):
```
- Perf: p95 latency <= 300ms at expected QPS (per-model)
- Throughput: >= 2x tokens/sec improvement vs baseline or cost reduction >= 15%
- Quality: no >1% regression on core prompt set (A/B eval)
- Robustness: automatic fallback on error-rate spike >0.5%
- Compatibility: kernels validated on listed HW
- Observability: tracing + token-level cost breakdown enabled
- Rollout: canary + auto-rollback on SLA breach
```

sophia: edge cases: short prompts can regress with larger batch sizes. add 'sequence-length-aware batching' acceptance. caching: must not serve stale completions after model swap — TTL and invalidation needed.

ravi: customer asks: per-customer cache controls (opt-in), audit logs for fallback, and a way to pin specific model/quant profile. add to acceptance.

elaine: updated action items: kevin will add perf scripts and thresholds; sophia will add eval promptsets + edge case tests; luca will publish hw matrix and run kernels; ravi will confirm pilot customers and cost targets. aim to converge by EOD Fri.

kevin: SGTM. I'll open a PR with the checklist and perf scripts link.

sophia: adding a note — include a tiny example of config for runtime policy:
```
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  sequence_length_aware: true
fallback:
  max_error_rate: 0.005
  fallbacks: ["fp16_model", "hosted_api"]
```

ravi: thanks all. If we hit the criteria, we'll greenlight canary next week.

elaine: thanks — that's the draft. feel free to emoji-react if you sign off :thumbsup:
